messages.text: Hi Winson, good to see you again. What can I help with today? Is it the Thor P2 delivery, the $220.99, or something else?

Great news, Winson, glad your Thor P2 made it to you.

Do you want to set it up now? Tell me how far you've got, whether it's still in the box, powered on, or already on your Wi-Fi, and we'll go step by step from there.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
I've passed your photo to our tech specialist. They'll answer in this chat.

Regarding the power cable, the original cable supplied has a 3-pin US plug. I requested a Malaysian plug, which should be a Type G (UK-style 3-pin plug), but the cable I received has a different plug. i get in the box is type C - EUROPEAN 2-OIN PLUG
Searched the catalog · UK plug power cable
Handed to the team · Wrong plug shipped, no standalone UK cable in the catalog to send; PSU fan quest

Sarah again, Winson, picking up the order side. I'm sorry, you asked for a Malaysian Type G plug and got a European 2-pin. That's our mistake.

We don't sell that cable on its own, so I can't send one from here myself. I've given the team both things, the wrong plug and the power supply fan that won't spin. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you with an answer, by email if you've left the chat.

Could you send a photo of the plug and the end that goes into the power supply? That way the team can match the right cable.

I've passed your question about the power supply fan to our tech specialist, and you'll get the answer here in this chat. The wrong plug is also with the team, and they'll get back to you about the right Type G cable.
